Subject: Evaluating Redwood — security gating & timeline

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the platform looks promising. Before we move to a pilot, my security & procurement teams need a short mutual acceptance plan that lays out: SOC 2 evidence access, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire status and expected completion, a DPA redline window and data retention commitments (we are particularly sensitive to retention of audit logs and any derived model artifacts).

High-level asks:
- Can you share your latest SOC 2 Type II report and a point of contact for test log access?
- What is your typical turnaround for a filled SIG/CAIQ (we prefer pre-populated where possible)?
- DPA: we have a couple of carveouts (EU residency for EU customer data, 7-year retention on specific regulated logs) — can Redwood support a DPA amendment and how long to redline?
- Proposed timeline: we were hoping to run a 4–6 week pilot from contract signature. Can you map milestones and evidence owners?

I attached a short MAP scope that our security lead sketched — it highlights the retention items. If you can propose a MAP with milestones and owners (Redwood v Clearport) that would help expedite procurement.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Thompson
VP, Information Security
Clearport Financial

Sam — thanks for the clear list and the MAP scope. I’ve pulled together a concise mutual acceptance playbook (attached) with owners and a proposed 6-week runway that aligns to your pilot window.

Summary (draft):
1) Week 0 — Kickoff & access: agree MAP, share contact list, provide SOC 2 cover letter and upload SOC 2 artifacts to a secure share (Redwood: Security; Clearport: Security). Owner: Redwood (Neha).
2) Week 1 — SIG/CAIQ: Redwood to deliver pre-populated SIG v2026 and highlight gaps/controls requiring evidence. Owner: Redwood Security (Neha).
3) Week 2–3 — DPA negotiation: Redwood legal to redline and return; targeted turnaround 5 business days. Owner: Redwood Legal, RedwoodSE (Lauren) to coordinate.
4) Week 3–4 — Evidence transfer & follow-ups: test logs, access walkthrough, on-call for questions. Owner: Redwood Security / Clearport Security.
5) Week 5 — Pilot sign-off criteria runbook & rollback plan. Owner: Clearport Product + Redwood CS (Ben).
6) Week 6 — Production readiness decision & contract signature finalization.

Notes & constraints:
- For the DPA retention ask (7 years on regulated logs), our standard practice is 1–3 year retention on operational logs, with longer-term archival available via managed export to customer-owned storage. We can propose an annex to cover 7-year retention if Clearport hosts exported logs in its own S3 with lifecycle rules.
- SOC 2 Type II: we cannot share raw test logs without an NDA or scoped access; however, we can provide the report, control descriptions, and a secure walkthrough.
- SIG turnaround: for pre-populated SIGs we typically return within 3 business days for standard customers; custom gaps may require 1–2 weeks for supporting evidence pull.

I’ve attached the draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_draft_v1.pdf). If this aligns, we’ll loop in Legal and Security to start the DPA redline and evidence scheduling.

Next step: Can you confirm Clearport’s preferred DPA path (redline in DocuSign vs. docx redline) and whether your security team needs on-site/VM access for log review?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
